name: The components were designed with full consideration of the extreme filling of Chinese text in domestic B-end business scenarios. Different width and height restrictions have been set for different components, allowing designers to simply fill in the corresponding Chinese text. Additionally, variables and component instructions are all in Chinese, improving the efficiency of designers.

name: When packaging Figma components, we provide designers with rich variables. A large number of visibility controls can help you respond more calmly to frequent changes from product managers. For high-frequency operations like icon changes, we offer surface-level operations that allow you to directly use the variable panel for dropdown actions. The rich slots cover various demand scenarios; whether the product requires you to add icons, labels, or logos, you just need to calmly toggle the switch for visual presentation. Detailed calling methods can be viewed in the [User Guide].
